locator.name: keeps no answer whose memory values failed, and reads it again on a refresh

proves.facet: With available after knowledge but unavailable memory facts, shared Refresh issues a second card request and recovers available facts; another Refresh/remount reuses that recovered answer. A separate legacy-unavailable after-side trees answer remains reusable rather than being retried as a transient failure.

locator.name: never shows an old answer under a new question

proves.facet: After INV-A cards resolve, rerendering the hook with INV-B shows loading and sends the INV-B question rather than exposing the INV-A cards.

locator.name: sends no second request when the same set remounts through pending and answer

proves.facet: Mounting the same sorted invariant set after an unmount while its request is pending issues one request; the second mount receives the shared answer and no second request is sent.

locator.name: shows a failed chunk on this mount and asks again on a remount

proves.facet: A mocked500/unreadable body yields visible unavailable on the first mount, and remounting the same invariant set sends a second request instead of retaining that failure.

locator.name: reads at most CARD_CHUNK invariants at a time

proves.facet: A request of two chunks plus one invariant emits 500, 500 and 1 identities and settles into one cards state.
